Houthis claim strikes on Saudi Shaybah oilfield, Aramco Yanbu site and Riyadh and Abha airports
events.summary: Yemen's Houthis said they attacked Saudi energy, airport and military targets including the Shaybah oilfield, an Aramco site in Yanbu, King Khalid airport in Riyadh and Abha airport; Saudi damage was not confirmed in the report.

events.title: Ukraine launches more than 1,000 drones at Russia, setting St Petersburg oil terminal and depot ablaze
events.summary: Russia's defence ministry said it downed about 1,015 Ukrainian drones overnight, one of the largest attacks of the war; fires hit the St Petersburg oil terminal, the Ruchyi oil depot and a VK data centre, with one person killed. Russia answered with about 300 drones.

events.title: IRGC says a second supertanker hit a naval mine in Hormuz and declares the strait closed
events.summary: Iran's IRGC said a second supertanker struck a naval mine on an unauthorized Strait of Hormuz route and declared the strait closed after the tanker hits; the vessels were not identified and the US says the strait is under US and partner control. The claims are unverified.

events.title: NBC: attacks on ships around the Strait of Hormuz reach record highs as Iran steps up strikes
events.summary: NBC News reported attacks on vessels around Hormuz have reached record levels with little US response; Reuters-cited tracking had already counted at least 12 tanker attacks in the week to Oct 5, the most since the war began.

events.title: UKMTO: tanker hit by unidentified projectile northeast of Saudi Arabia's Jubail
events.summary: UKMTO reported a tanker was struck by an unidentified projectile northeast of Jubail on Friday; the crew was safe and evacuated. It extends Gulf shipping attacks beyond the Strait of Hormuz into Saudi waters.

events.title: IRGC says a supertanker caught fire after hitting a naval mine on an 'unauthorized' Hormuz route
events.summary: Iran's Revolutionary Guards said an oil tanker ignited after striking a naval mine while using what they called an unauthorized route through the Strait of Hormuz; the vessel was not identified and the claim was not independently verified. It follows similar IRGC claims on Oct 10 (supertanker) and Oct 14 (container ship).

events.title: Tasnim: Yemeni drone attacks on Dammam halt airport activity
events.summary: Iran's Tasnim News reported Yemeni drone attacks on Dammam in Saudi Arabia's Eastern Province and said activity at Dammam airport was halted; not independently confirmed.

events.title: Indian official says crude tanker targeted by missile in Strait of Hormuz
events.summary: An Indian shipping official said a crude oil tanker was targeted by a missile in the Strait of Hormuz on Friday and also referred to the recent Romania-linked tanker incident; it adds to this week's string of attacks on Gulf shipping.

events.title: Ukrainian drones hit Surgut condensate plant in Russia's largest oil-producing region
events.summary: A suspected Ukrainian drone attack started a fire at an industrial facility in the Surgut district of Khanty-Mansi, identified by residents as Gazprom Pererabotka's Surgut Condensate Stabilization Plant, Russia's largest such facility; it appears to be the first strike on energy infrastructure in the region, and Surgut and Kogalym airports were restricted.

events.title: Tehran seeks to punish Trump in the midterms with oil price pain, Iranian officials say
events.summary: The Washington Post reported that Iranian officials said Tehran aims to keep oil prices high ahead of the US midterm elections.

events.title: Houthi missile hits Saudi Aramco headquarters in Dhahran; Houthis vow more attacks on Saudi oil sites
events.summary: A Houthi ballistic missile struck an office tower at Aramco's Dhahran complex late on 13 October, causing a fire; Saudi officials said there were no injuries and operations continued. Brent settled near $106 on 14 October and the Houthis vowed further strikes on Saudi oil facilities and airports.

events.title: Saudi-led coalition says Houthis attempted to attack dozens of Saudi facilities
events.summary: The Saudi-led coalition said the Houthis attempted to attack dozens of Saudi facilities, a day after Houthi fire was intercepted over the Medina region and following the strike on Aramco's Dhahran headquarters.

events.title: Trump endorses Netanyahu and warns the US could soon 'finish the job' against Iran
events.summary: In a Truth Social post nine days before Israel's Oct 27 election, Trump endorsed Netanyahu and said that unless Iran changes course quickly the US would soon finish the job; Araghchi replied Iran has unfinished jobs too.

events.title: Trump waives some Russia sanctions, restrictions and energy-linked duties under the Graham Act
events.summary: Trump signed an executive order waiving application of certain sanctions, restrictions and duties under the Sanctioning Russia and Iran Act (signed Sept 18, initial measures due Oct 18) and certified to Congress that the waivers serve US national interests; Bloomberg says the waivers cover Russia energy tariffs.

events.title: Araghchi says Iran's seven-day plan still stands and Hormuz could reopen Friday if the US accepts
events.summary: Iran's foreign minister said the conditional plan, which asks for about $12 billion in frozen assets, oil-sanction relief and an end to the US naval blockade, could reopen Hormuz on day six; Trump earlier called the terms not acceptable.

events.title: Ukraine hits Russian oil refinery as it resumes strikes; oil rises
events.summary: Russia accused Ukraine of attacking an oil refinery after Zelenskyy said strikes would resume, and Axios reported Ukraine hit a Russian refinery; WSJ said oil rose on the Russia strikes.

events.title: Saudi-led coalition intercepts missile over Medina region; Houthis deny targeting the city
events.summary: The Saudi-led coalition said it intercepted and destroyed a cruise missile over the Medina region on 15 Oct, two days after the Houthi strike on Aramco's Dhahran headquarters; the Houthis denied targeting the holy city.

events.title: Ukraine to resume strikes on Russian refineries, Zelenskyy tells FT
events.summary: Zelenskyy told the Financial Times Ukraine will restart strikes on Russian oil refineries after a three-day pause under Trump's 'energy ceasefire', saying Russia kept attacking Ukraine's energy system.

events.title: Unite announces 24-hour strike by Apache North Sea workers, warns of UK fuel disruption
events.summary: Unite says more than 160 Apache offshore workers on Forties-linked assets will strike for 24 hours; it warns the Forties Pipeline System (about 29% of UK oil) could be disrupted, while Apache says contingency plans should keep it running.

events.title: Brent dips about 2% to $108 after US waives Russia oil sanctions
events.summary: Crude fell about 2% to around $108 a barrel early Monday after hitting its highest level since May, as the US pause on Russia sanctions raised expectations of more Russian supply; WTI slipped to near $97.50.

web.title: ProFrac (NASDAQ:ACDC) shares gap down
web.takeaway: ProFrac reported a quarterly loss of $0.47 per share, $0.10 worse than estimates, on revenue of $449.6 million that beat expectations.

web.title: ProFrac (ACDC) Stock Is Up, What You Need To Know
web.takeaway: ProFrac shares rose 4.7% after Piper Sandler raised its price target to $6 from $5 with a Neutral rating, amid the energy rally tied to the Strait of Hormuz.

fundamentals.description: ProFrac provides hydraulic fracturing, proppant production and other well completion services.
